title: Property Showcase
description: Horizontal scrolling gallery of featured properties with pricing and location. Grayscale-to-color hover effect. Admin selects which properties appear.

inScope: Horizontal scroll container for property cards
Property cards with grayscale-to-color hover effect
Price badges (Rp 2.5 M, Rp 35 jt/bln, etc.)
outOfScope: Property detail page navigation (handled by F-012)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Property cards display in horizontal scroll container
Cards show grayscale image that transitions to color on hover
Each card shows price badge, property name, and location
Admin can select which properties appear in showcase via dashboard
Clicking a card navigates to property detail page
